notes.addenda: The reading agent starts after the Oct 11 census apply; until then a mismatch is read against the college's addendum by hand.
notes.procedures: 34 colleges have one since Oct 8: the 28 whose map host refuses or never reaches the reader each name the routes tried.
notes.sierra: The funding explainer's text is editable on the Implementation Funding tab since Oct 9, and its controls are underlined words, the First Light rule from that day.
notes.maps: All 32 published maps are settled since Oct 8; Palo Verde's map columns were written that evening.
notes.reading: Cerritos read on Oct 9 and Mt. San Antonio on Oct 10. RCCD's three colleges were read on Oct 10 and their Liberal Arts emphasis programs recovered on Oct 11. 18 records that read another program's page were removed on Oct 11. Long Beach City was read on Oct 11 and re-read on Oct 12: 344 records, unchecked. Chaffey was read and loaded on Oct 12: 191 records, unchecked, for 1,745 in all.
